title: To Kill a Mockingbird
description: A young girl in a small Alabama town watches her father defend a Black man falsely accused of a crime, and comes of age against a backdrop of racial injustice.

title: The Great Gatsby
description: Jay Gatsby's obsessive pursuit of the wealthy Daisy Buchanan unfolds against the glittering, hollow excess of Jazz Age New York.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: Elizabeth Bennet navigates courtship, family pressure, and her own quick judgments in a sharp comedy of manners set in Regency England.

title: Brave New World
description: In a future engineered for stability and pleasure, one man's discontent exposes the cost of a society that has traded freedom for comfort.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
description: Teenager Holden Caulfield wanders New York City over a few days, wrestling with alienation, grief, and the phoniness of the adult world.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
description: Seven generations of the Buendía family live and die in the mythical town of Macondo, in a landmark work of magical realism.

title: Crime and Punishment
description: A destitute former student murders a pawnbroker in St. Petersburg, then spirals through guilt, paranoia, and the possibility of redemption.

title: Fahrenheit 451
description: In a future where books are outlawed and burned on sight, a fireman tasked with destroying them begins to question everything he's been taught.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
description: Moments before Earth is demolished for a hyperspace bypass, an ordinary Englishman is swept into a chaotic, comic tour of the galaxy.

title: Ender's Game
description: A brilliant child is trained at a military academy in orbit to command Earth's fleet against an alien threat, at a devastating personal cost.

title: Neuromancer
description: A washed-up computer hacker is hired for one last job that plunges him into a conspiracy spanning cyberspace and artificial intelligence.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
description: In a totalitarian theocracy that has stripped women of their rights, a handmaid clings to memory and small acts of resistance.

title: Snow Crash
description: A pizza-delivery hacker and a skateboard courier uncover a linguistic virus threatening both the virtual Metaverse and the real world.

title: And Then There Were None
description: Ten strangers are lured to an isolated island and killed off one by one, each death matching a sinister nursery rhyme.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
description: A disgraced journalist and a brilliant, damaged hacker investigate a decades-old disappearance that uncovers a family's dark secrets.

title: Gone Girl
description: When Amy Dunne vanishes on her fifth wedding anniversary, suspicion falls on her husband — and nothing about their marriage is what it seemed.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
description: A young FBI trainee turns to an imprisoned cannibal killer for insight while hunting a serial murderer at large.

title: A Study in Scarlet
description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson meet for the first time and take on a baffling London murder with no apparent motive.

title: Educated
subtitle: A Memoir
description: Raised by survivalist parents in rural Idaho with no schooling, the author claws her way to a PhD from Cambridge — and reckons with what that costs her family.

title: Atomic Habits
subtitle: An Easy & Proven Way to Build Good Habits & Break Bad Ones
description: A practical framework for behaviour change built on small, compounding improvements rather than dramatic overhauls.

title: The Power of Habit
subtitle: Why We Do What We Do in Life and Business
description: A tour of the science behind habit formation, from individual routines to how organizations and movements are built around them.

title: Man's Search for Meaning
description: A psychiatrist's account of surviving Nazi concentration camps, and the theory of meaning-driven resilience he drew from it.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
description: A Nobel laureate's account of the two systems that drive human judgment — one fast and intuitive, the other slow and deliberate.

title: Outliers
subtitle: The Story of Success
description: An argument that extraordinary success owes as much to timing, culture, and hidden opportunity as it does to individual talent.

description: A methodology for building startups through rapid experimentation, validated learning, and iterative product releases.

subtitle: Notes on Startups, or How to Build the Future
description: A contrarian case for building genuinely new things rather than incrementally improving on what already exists.

title: Good to Great
subtitle: Why Some Companies Make the Leap and Others Don't
description: A five-year research project identifies the disciplined practices that separate merely good companies from truly great ones.

title: Built to Last
subtitle: Successful Habits of Visionary Companies
description: A study of enduring, visionary companies and the core values and long-term thinking that set them apart.

description: A physicist's plain-language tour of cosmology, from the origin of the universe to the nature of time itself.

title: The Selfish Gene

title: Astrophysics for People in a Hurry
description: A brisk, accessible primer on the universe — from the Big Bang to dark matter — for readers with no time to spare.
